# TradeHQ

> TradeHQ is a free educational paper-trading simulator for stocks, crypto, ETFs, forex and commodities. Core simulator use starts with $100,000 in virtual cash and does not require a brokerage deposit.

TradeHQ is not a brokerage and does not execute real-money orders. Market-data provenance varies by feature and instrument: a value may be realtime provider data, delayed or previous-close provider data, cached data, a proxy, or explicitly simulated data. User-facing labels should be checked on the relevant page rather than assuming every value is live or every value is simulated.

The TradeHQ Mentor uses an AI chat service when available and a static educational topic-library fallback when that service is unavailable. It is not a personalized investment-advice or price-prediction service.

Community leaderboard, public-profile and duel statistics are simulated practice statistics synced from client-held state and are not independently audited performance records.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://www.thetradehq.com/): Product overview and entry points to the virtual-money simulator.
- [Trade](https://www.thetradehq.com/trade): Practice trading terminal for supported simulated instruments; data provenance varies by instrument.
- [Markets](https://www.thetradehq.com/markets): Simulator market browser across stocks, crypto, ETFs, forex and commodities.
- [Portfolio](https://www.thetradehq.com/portfolio): Virtual positions, recorded trades, P&L, allocation and local-history drawdown metrics.
- [Leaderboard](https://www.thetradehq.com/leaderboard): Community board using client-synced simulated statistics that are not independently verified.
- [TradeHQ Mentor](https://www.thetradehq.com/ai-mentor): Educational Q&A using an AI service when available and a static fallback otherwise.
- [About](https://www.thetradehq.com/about): Mission and product transparency.
- [Contact](https://www.thetradehq.com/contact): Contact and correction channel.

## Learn

- [Learn hub](https://www.thetradehq.com/learn): Structured educational material and simulator exercises.
- [Trading Guide](https://www.thetradehq.com/learn-trading-guide): Beginner-to-intermediate educational guide.
- [Structured Courses](https://www.thetradehq.com/courses): Course tracks with quizzes and completion badges.
- [Options Trading Fundamentals](https://www.thetradehq.com/courses/options-trading-fundamentals): Educational coverage of calls, puts, Greeks, spreads and risk.
- [Futures & Derivatives](https://www.thetradehq.com/courses/futures-and-derivatives): Educational coverage of contracts, margin, term structure and hedging.
- [Macro Reading for Traders](https://www.thetradehq.com/courses/macro-reading-for-traders): Educational coverage of inflation, central banks, yield curves and currencies.
- [Trading Psychology](https://www.thetradehq.com/courses/trading-psychology-mastery): Biases, journaling and drawdown concepts.
- [Roadmap](https://www.thetradehq.com/roadmap): Current feature status plus in-progress and planned items.

## Wiki

- [Trading Wiki](https://www.thetradehq.com/wiki/short-squeeze): Plain-English educational definitions of trading and market concepts.

## Comparisons

Comparison pages explain structural differences and do not choose a universally better asset or provide a buy recommendation.

- [All comparisons](https://www.thetradehq.com/compare)
